summary: Shelf Ledger: A simple personal library tracker that records every book you own, who borrowed it, and whether it's currently out — all in one glanceable list.
implemented_features: Add a book to the collection
Filter to see only lent-out books
See how many books are lent out
assumptions: Built for A single user managing their home book collection on their own computer..
Persistence decision: Browser localStorage under key 'shelf-ledger-books'; load with malformed-data recovery (fall back to empty array on parse failure).

tests_run.journey: Generated journey suite passed: Add a book, lend it, verify it appears in the lent-only filter and the count increments; Add two books, edit one's title, delete the other, verify the list and count are correct; Add a book, lend it, return it, verify it leaves the lent-only filter and count returns to zero
